name: floating slab track
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过弹性或隔振支承将轨道板与基础相隔离的轨道结构。
usage_overview: 通过板下弹性支承实现隔振，用于车辆—轨道及其与下部结构耦合系统的减振分析和现场验证。研究可考察轨道板位移等响应；离散支承或点弹簧是其中的支承布置或建模方式。

complete_examples.text: Results show that the stochastic simulation of the vehicle–floating slab track system using PDEM is efficient and reliable compared with the Monte Carlo method.

Finally, stochastic analyses of the dynamic response and the vibration isolation performance of the floating slab track are carried out using the coupled vehicle–floating slab track system dynamics model.
In this section, based on the substructure coordination method, the effects of damping fasteners, damping pads and floating slab track on near- and far-field ground vibration mitigation are analyzed.

In general, among the three kinds of isolation vibration track, the damping fastener has the best vibration damping performance, and the floating slab track has the worst vibration damping performance.
For the damping pad and the floating slab track with similar vibration frequencies, the vibration damping performance is quite different.
